name: kettlebell lateral lunge
description: Side lunge holding a kettlebell at the chest. It trains the thighs, glutes and inner thighs in the frontal plane.
instructions: Hold the kettlebell at your chest with both hands and stand tall.
Take a big step to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and both feet flat.
Push back to the start and alternate sides.
